items.headline: Leverage Shares by Themes Readies 2x Leveraged and Short Anthropic ETFs ANUU, ANDD, and ANSS Ahead of ANT IPO
items.excerpt: As Anthropic prepares for an anticipated public listing, Leverage Shares by Themes is getting ready to launch ANUU, ANDD and ANSS: three leveraged and inverse Anthropic ETFs linked to the company's stock (expected ticker: ANT). GREENWICH, Conn., Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- With...
